notes: option_ids lists every customizer option that writes this variable in ANY scope (global or a component such as a Woo card). To change the global value, use the option whose dynamic-styles selector is :root; see references/design-tokens.md.
value_in_global_css is from the snapshot site; read live values with the tokens command.
--has-* variables are internal boolean switches (var(--true)/var(--false)); do not set them from block markup.
